  • provenance.absent (Provenance, missing): The manifest declares no provenance, so no component origin is on record and the policy's provenance rules (critical_country_denylist, critical_final_assembly_denylist, covered_vendor_denylist, hbom_required_for_critical, attestation_floor) have nothing to check.

  • validated.too-high (Programs, checked, fail): Program too-high.urml.yaml is refused, 2 errors. envelope.altitude_exceeded: move_to.pose.z (80.0 m) exceeds the strictest altitude cap (60.0 m); envelope.geofence_violation: move_to.pose (50.0, 40.0, alt=80.0) is inside the footprint of a declared geofence but outside its altitude band (['delivery_corridor']).
